observe.text:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open the Kern demo store.
Click the button labelled 'Load $60.00 eligible cart'.
On the shipping quote page, read the amount shown on the line starting with 'Shipping' and store it as observed_shipping.
Read the amount shown on the line starting with 'Merchandise subtotal' and store it as observed_subtotal.
Do not place an order and do not enter any payment details.

verdict.rootCause: The store applied a shipping charge even though the cart subtotal was $60.00 and the store says US orders of $50.00 or more receive free standard shipping.
verdict.bugTitle: Eligible $60 cart is charged standard shipping
verdict.suggestion: Fix the free-shipping rule so US standard-shipping carts with an after-discount merchandise subtotal of $50.00 or more show $0.00 shipping, then add a regression check for the $60.00 eligible-cart fixture.
verdict.oneLiner: The $60 eligible cart showed a $9.00 standard-shipping charge instead of free shipping.

signals.excerpt: Free standard shipping on US orders of $50.00 or more. After-discount merchandise subtotal, USD, standard shipping.

raw.root_cause: The store applied a shipping charge even though the cart subtotal was $60.00 and the store says US orders of $50.00 or more receive free standard shipping.
raw.agent_fault_assessment: The agent followed the requested path: it clicked the exact '$60.00 eligible cart' fixture, reached the shipping quote, and evaluated the stated shipping condition. It did not cause the $9.00 charge or misread the requested line; the displayed subtotal, destination, shipping method, and policy all establish eligibility for free standard shipping.
raw.bug_title: Eligible $60 cart is charged standard shipping

signals.excerpt: Free standard shipping on US orders of $50.00 or more. After-discount merchandise subtotal, USD, standard shipping.

raw.suggestion: Fix the free-shipping rule so US standard-shipping carts with an after-discount merchandise subtotal of $50.00 or more show $0.00 shipping, then add a regression check for the $60.00 eligible-cart fixture.
raw.one_liner: The $60 eligible cart showed a $9.00 standard-shipping charge instead of free shipping.

assertVerdict.rootCause: The store applied a shipping charge even though the cart subtotal was $60.00 and the store says US orders of $50.00 or more receive free standard shipping.
assertVerdict.bugTitle: Eligible $60 cart is charged standard shipping

reasons: oracle expected 0 cents; Kane observed 900; assert failed with a confirmed verdict
notes: observe and assert are provided real captures; exit codes are user-reported because the NDJSON does not record them.
